source_comparison.method: Token comparisons preserve strings, ignore comments/whitespace/optional trailing commas, and normalize module facades, qualified memory paths, narrowed installation-helper scope, restored object-family storage/fixture scope and fixture hook/import routing. All moved phase/storage bodies and remaining registry/backing/transfer/close/pin/retirement code match. Module reexports reviewed separately; no old storage alias retained. Review aid, not formal refinement.

limitations: Mechanical source comparisons aid review, not formal refinement.
Shared mapping records, retirement pins, namespace/loan retirement and backing custody retain their existing owners and contexts.
No physical completion/replay authority from retained allocation, an empty prefix, a missing leaf or an error diagnostic.
Outer IRQ/guard/destructor, broader pressure/fairness and aggregate resource qualification remain separate.
No model change or attribution of historical scheduler/metrics/root-close/mapping failures.
Tracked boot diffs omit untracked new modules; explicit frozen Rust hashes identify the complete changed source set.
